messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticing a spike in unassigned HubSpot leads since 10:15am. Lots stuck in enrichment pending state. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking_face:
sam: seeing it too. round-robin assignment seems to skip when enrichment webhook takes >30s. we get transient duplicates then nothing gets claimed.
liam: looks like HS webhook latencies spiked to 600ms->8s around 10:12. enrichment service retried and created duplicate contact events.
maya: impact: SDR queue not getting notifications, inbound funnel looks like a blackhole for 5–10m. we need a quick fallback.
carla-sdr-lead: i'm getting manual tickets from reps. can we set a short fallback owner so leads don't sit unowned? :rotating_light:
sam: proposal: set fallback_owner = `sdr-inbox` after 45s of no claim. also add a new rule to prevent claim races: if `claim_attempts > 1` within 2s ignore duplicate.
maya: +1. also add a de-dup by `email` + recent update window (5s) in HS workflow to suppress double events.
ashley: can we add an observability pulse? i can add a Datadog monitor for `lead.claim.latency` > 30s and an alert to #marketing oncall.
liam: quick detection query I ran in BigQuery:
``
SELECT contact_id, created_at, owner, enrichment_status
FROM inbound_leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-21'
AND owner IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
liam: result shows ~78 unowned leads between 10:10 and 10:20, enrichment_status = 'pending' for most.
maya: ok i'm going to patch the routing service to add the 45s fallback and enable the de-dupe flag in HS workflow. will deploy to staging first.
deploy-bot: started deployment: routing-fallback-45s to staging by maya at 2026-03-21T10:38:12Z
sam: thanks. please also add a short changelog note and update runbook.
maya: patch applied to staging, smoke tests pass. promoting to prod in 5.
deploy-bot: promoted routing-fallback-45s to production at 2026-03-21T10:44:03Z
carla-sdr-lead: saw a handful of leads land in sdr-inbox — good so far. reps reporting fewer misses.
ashley: Datadog monitor created: lead.claim.latency > 30s for 5m -> alert #marketing-oncall. i also added a dashboard widget.
liam: follow-up: we'll need a postmortem and decide if SLA should change from 30s->45s for claim TTL or if we should invest in faster enrichment.
maya: agreed. scheduling a 30-min check-in at 3pm today to review metrics and decide permanent config. tagging @sam @liam @carla-sdr-lead
sam: +1. i'll clean up the HS workflow rules and add unit tests for de-dupe.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-03121-HS-LATENCY — assignees: sam, liam, maya
maya: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. will post brief summary after the 3pm sync. :thumbsup:
